_meta.policy: Metabot database fields = data (1 source ok). Advice/orders need 2 independent sources; else verdict single/inferred.

skillRules.costsPerLevel: L2-4: 1 pt, L5-7: 2 pts, L8-10: 4 pts (21 pts per skill 1->10); identical on all 11 Metabot skill pages fetched
skillRules.above10: only from gear options, Arcana, Daevanion nodes (thegameswiki skills-and-specialties; gameplay.tips skills guide)
skillRules.specialtyOptions: options unlock at skill Lv 8 (3 options), 12 (4th), 16 (5th); slots: 1 at 8, 2 at 12, 3 at 20 (gameplay.tips; thegameswiki says 8/12/20 slots are KR player reports; Metabot class page 8/12/20)

skills.name: Heart Gore
skills.gate: char Lv for skill level L (2..10) = learnLv + 3*(L-2) (L10 @ 28)

options: Up to +20% Critical Hit when less targets hit
Resets [Heart Gore] cooldown on landing a Critical Hit

skills.name: Insignia Explosion
skills.gate: char Lv for skill level L (2..10) = learnLv + 3*(L-2) (L10 @ 38)

options: Keeps 2 Insignia stacks after Insignia Explosion

skills.name: Quick Slice
skills.gate: char Lv for skill level L (2..10) = learnLv + 3*(L-2) (L10 @ 25)

options: Ignores Block and Evasion and lands as a Critical Hit

skills.name: Flash Slice
skills.gate: char Lv for skill level L (2..10) = learnLv + 3*(L-2) (L10 @ 32)

options: Up to 20% more damage when hitting more targets
50% chance to rotate and Stun 3s when hitting a Blind target

skills.note: 10s cooldown; moves to opposite side of target within 4m, up to 4 enemies.

Assault Stance.basis: GamesFuze (passives: Rear Smite+Exploit Weakness, then Assault Stance, then Impact Hit); Skycoach (EW+RS first, then Assault Stance and Impact Hit); games.gg (max RS, Assault Stance, EW, Defense Break, Determination); Metabot class-builds (Nezekan Assault Stance + EW node pairs first)

Impact Hit.basis: GamesFuze, Skycoach (after Assault Stance); games.gg says invest but small per-level gain

Flash Slice.basis: GamesFuze active priority #6 (after HG, IE, SR, SS, QS); Skycoach Flash Slice to 12

Defense Break.basis: games.gg passive max order (4th). Metabot class-builds recommends its Zikel nodes, which is board advice, not SP.

spOrderAfterCore.interleave: inferred: no source orders passives against actives; R3 put the two 2-source passives first because they are always-on and Assault Stance is named by all four sources
spOrderAfterCore.budget: core 8 = 168 pts; LEVEL_POINTS[45]=203 -> 35 pts + Wisdom Stones from quests/dungeons. Assault Stance 1->10 = 21, Impact Hit = 21; gates: AS L10 needs char 37, IH L10 needs 39.
spOrderAfterCore.verdict: 2-source for Assault Stance > Impact Hit and Flash Slice > Storm Rampage; rest single; interleave inferred

levelPoints.verdict: 45=203: 2-source. 30-44: single (Wikily); matches LEVEL_POINTS exactly. App note says game matched at Lv 12/13.

boards.listVerdict: 2-source+ : five boards on global, Azphel at 45 (Metabot guide + Metabot assassin board data + GameWith planner; Skycoach gives same levels 20/30/40/45).

Triniel totals: Multi-hit Chance +4.5% and Multi-hit Resist +4.5% (no crit-damage or speed % stat) => +1.5% Multi-Hit Chance corners (inferred). The app's generic 'Corner' can be named this.

boards.pathCostsNote: Metaroad board page refused (provenance) and GameWith grid is unlabelled; Metabot gives no node coordinates. Path costs unknown; keep 'about 3–5 with its path' only as labelled inference or drop.
boards.ArielNote: Not on global by 45. Metabot (guide + assassin board data) and GameWith list exactly 5 boards with no Ariel; Skycoach: 'Ariel (PvE) and Azphel (PvP): Level 45 … Ariel is currently absent on Global'. MeinMMO and gameplay.tips name Ariel (gameplay.tips also Marchutan, Yustiel) without unlock levels, likely KR info. => tip 'Five boards … Azphel (45)' is right; Ahead row 'Ariel and Azphel boards' is wrong (use 'Azphel board (PvP)').
boards.skillLevelNote: Board nodes add +1 'above the normal cap' (Metabot skill pages); none says whether they count toward specialty unlocks.

stigmas.name: Illusive Clone
stigmas.note: 90s cd; removes Heart Gore cooldown + 20% extra damage for 10s (L1) / 30s (max). Specialties at stigma Lv 5/10/15/20.

stigmaRules.availability: All 13 Assassin stigmas learnable at char Lv 22 once 'The One Who Hears the Voice' (third Ascension) is done; no per-stigma acquisition. Sources: Metabot stigma-guide, allthings.how ?p=244997, PlayNews ('unlock any Stigma for your class from the Skills menu'), thegameswiki stigma-system (all 13 at 22). Verdict 2-source+. => Illusive Clone IS learnable at 22 (and at 27).
stigmaRules.slots: 22/27/32/37, 4 on global (Metabot content-unlocks, Metabot stigma-guide, Wikily, allthings.how, PlayNews). thegameswiki: 5 since 25 Mar 2026 on KR/TW.

equipOrder.verdict: No 2-source slot-by-level order. GamesFuze+Skycoach agree TD then IC as top two (supports app slots 1-2; these are priority lists, so equip timing is inferred). Slots 3-4: Metabot+Skycoach put Swift Contract before Savage Fang; GamesFuze the reverse. App's SF 32 / SC 37 is the minority order. Same four stigmas in all three sources (2-source+).
equipOrder.upgradePriority: Triniel's Dagger to 10 and Illusive Clone to 20 (GamesFuze + Skycoach, 2-source). App plan 'all to 5, then slot 1 to 10/15' is Metabot general advice (single).

stigmaCost.table: stigma Lv 1-5: 1 shard each, 6-10: 2, 11-15: 4, 16-20: 8 (cumulative 5/15/35/75). Lv 21+: Superior Stigma Shards.
stigmaCost.shardIncome: 1 point from the Ascension reward (= learn cost of first stigma); +1 per char level 23-39; +2 per level 40-45; cumulative from leveling 5@27, 10@32, 15@37, 19@40, 29@45 (30 incl. Ascension). Shops: Shugo Festival cap 35, Abyss Point Exchange 200, Nightmare 35 (PlayNews; Abyss/Nightmare shops at 45).
stigmaCost.verdict: 2-source (Metabot, allthings.how agree on table, learn=1 shard, income). Not seen on an in-game screen; independence of allthings.how from Metabot not provable. thegameswiki/PlayNews give no numbers.
stigmaCost.implication: From leveling alone (30 points by 45) TD to 10 (15) + 3 others learned (3) = 18 fits; IC to 20 (75) does not before 45.

unlocks.quest: Daeva in a Dream (feature gate; seen in game ~22)

unlocks.storyStep: Canyon's Secret (rec 30) step 2 'complete the Urugugu Canyon investigation'
unlocks.verdict: Level 28 / IL 300 / 2–5: 4-5 sources (game data). No source names a per-dungeon unlock quest; Metabot Canyon's Secret lists no unlock reward. Whether the canyon is enterable before reaching that story step is NOT verified in game.
unlocks.note: Story step likely runs this expedition (inferred: same name; Wikily's Elyos 'Fire Temple' quest lists the Expedition as its objective). Canyon's Secret reward = Aullaeu Wings. If the step needs the 2–5 party version, the user may need a party for the story; unknown.

unlocks.storyStep: Mirror of Greed (rec 37) step 2 'complete the Fire Temple investigation'
unlocks.verdict: Level 35 / IL 500: 4 sources. Party: 1–5 (Metabot, expcarry); 'up to 5' (Wikily, thegameswiki). No per-dungeon unlock quest named. Not verified in game.
unlocks.note: Elyos counterpart quest 'Fire Temple' (Wikily, rec 37): objective 'Investigate the Fire Temple by entering it', objective type Expedition; journal: a passage 'has opened nearby'. Mirror of Greed reward: Fire Temple Accessory Selection Chest (Metabot). => the story step is a run of this expedition (2 sources, inferred for Asmodian).

thegameswiki (Oct 7 2026): NCsoft hadn't listed which Expedition dungeons are open in the global build; its tables are KR/TW (it also says weekly Expedition reward limits were removed there on 1 Jul 2026, while Metabot gives 7 per dungeon per week: disputed for global). Metabot's tables are global client data.

unlocksRecommendation: P0-2: keep 28 / 35 as the listed entry level (multi-source game data) but not as 'verified unlock' unless seen in game; add story chips: Urugugu -> 'Canyon's Secret' (Lv 30) and Fire Temple -> 'Mirror of Greed' (Lv 37) as 'the story sends you in here'. Krao precedent: listed Lv 20, opened at ~22 because of the feature quest; for 28/35 the feature is already unlocked, so no evidence of a later gate.
